name: Acunetix MCP Server
description: Exposes the Acunetix Scanner API as a streamable HTTP MCP server, allowing clients to interact with security scanning tools via standardized requests. It enables automated vulnerability management and integration with platforms like GhostReconRev through a containerized bridge.
